events.body:
## Context

`scripts/generate_page.py` builds every "Idea X" badge, matrix label, header button and repo link from `REPO_URL = https://github.com/OWASP-BLT/...` and `IDEA_REPO_MAP` values like `OWASP-BLT/<Repo>`. The hero card links to the forge but is labelled "View on GitHub".

## What to do

1. Add a `FORGE_URL` constant; build file links as `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/blob/main/blt-ideas/{filename}`.
2. Make `IDEA_REPO_MAP` values bare repo names linking to `https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/{name}`.
3. Fix the hero card label and icon. Leave GitHub Discussions links and GitHub API calls alone.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `grep -c 'github.com/OWASP-BLT' dist/index.html` is 0 apart from discussion links
- [ ] Badges open the right file on the forge
- [ ] Repo filter still lists repo names

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-ideas && python3 scripts/generate_page.py && python3 -m http.server -d dist 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
